subject: Post-demo: decision criteria, procurement steps & champion comms
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finexa.com>, Maya Rodriguez <maya@mayasolutions.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <viveek@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-24T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo: decision criteria, procurement steps & champion comms

Hi Raj / Maya — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap + agreed next steps so we have a single source of truth for your team and ours.

Summary of what we heard (your inputs):
- Primary objective: replace a homegrown inference service with predictable latency and cost for the personalization pipeline.
- Decision criteria you flagged:
  - Latency under 120ms p95 for 256-token requests
  - Predictable unit economics and a clear cost model for 100–500M tokens/month
  - Security & data handling: SOC 2 evidence, option for VPC/private deployment, retention controls
  - SLA & business continuity (failover to another region)
- Timeline: target procurement/PO by end of July; pilot in Aug if procurement clears.

Stakeholders we identified on the call:
- Economic buyer / sponsor: Raj Patel (you) — responsible for budget sign-off and final approval.
- Security / compliance reviewer: Maya Rodriguez — will own the technical security questionnaire and SOC 2 evidence review.
- Procurement contact: procurement@finexa.com — handling PO/contract routing (CC them on procurement docs).

Immediate next steps (owners + dates):
1) Camila (me) — share a one-page champion comms template and a draft SOW + security checklist by Friday 6/26. (attachment: champion-comm-template.docx; Finexa_SOW_draft_v1.pdf; security-checklist.xlsx)
2) Raj — share the internal decision criteria spreadsheet and confirm procurement contact timeline by 6/29.
3) Maya — we'll upload SOC 2 and a short answers doc; please flag any additional evidence needed by 7/2.
4) Redwood (Rishi + Vivek) — prepare a firm pricing quote and PO template once we have clarity on target QPS and retention settings (aiming to deliver 6/28).

Champion enablement notes (talk tracks Raj can use internally):
- Quick pitch: "Redwood gives us predictable per-token economics and enterprise controls so our personalization models scale without surprise costs."
- ROI snippets to highlight: we estimate a 30–45% reduction in per-token inference cost using batching/KV caching on your workload profile; typical latency p95 target met with our default config for similar customers.
- Ask for the CFO: a one-liner: "Committed monthly capacity reduces unit cost and provides an SLA for peak trading windows."

Please confirm I've captured everything or add if I missed a stakeholder. We'll send the attachments and the pricing draft Friday morning.

Thanks — Camila
Camila Reyes
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

From: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finexa.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>, Maya Rodriguez <maya@mayasolutions.com>
Cc: procurement@finexa.com
Date: 2026-06-25T09:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: decision criteria, procurement steps & champion comms

Camila — thanks for the clear recap. Looks right to me. Couple quick asks from our side:

- Can you send a concise pricing range (ballpark committed vs. burst) and a sample SOW/statement of work I can share with the CFO today? He wants the high level numbers and the PO flow.
- Procurement wants a PO template and any standard redlines we typically accept/not accept. They prefer to see the payment terms and a sample contract before we put the item on the July procurement review calendar.

Timeline: we are pushing to have procurement queue this in the July 12 procurement review so we can get a PO executed by end of July. If you can provide the materials this week it will help.

Thanks — Raj
Raj Patel
VP, Product & Data, Finexa
raj.patel@finexa.com | +1 617-555-0910

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj.patel@finexa.com>, Maya Rodriguez <maya@mayasolutions.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <viveek@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, procurement@finexa.com
Date: 2026-06-26T11:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo: decision criteria, procurement steps & champion comms

Thanks Raj — sending the materials below and looping in our pricing/ops folks. Attachments included: Finexa_SOW_draft_v1.pdf, security-checklist.xlsx, champion-comm-template.docx (one-pager Raj can forward).

Pricing (ballpark, subject to config/final QPS):
- Committed (reserved capacity) monthly commit: $22k–$35k/month for the baseline config we discussed (predictable throughput and private VPC option).
- Hosted burst/overage: metered at $0.0006–$0.0012 per token depending on throughput tier and quantization profile.
- Typical pilot credit / playbook: recommend a 30–60 day pilot with a capped spend of ~$10k to validate latency and integration.

Champion comms (pasteable for Raj):
- 3-line elevator: "Redwood Inference will lower inference cost and guarantee predictable latency for our personalization models while providing enterprise-grade controls (VPC, KMS, SOC 2)."
- Top ROI bullets to call out:
  - Estimated 30–45% reduction in per-token inference cost using our batching + KV caching defaults on your workload.
  - Pilot-to-production path: pilot (30–60d) -> dedicated commit (monthly) -> private deployment (if you require VPC).
  - SLAs & fallbacks: regional failover with a backed SLA option for dedicated customers.

Procurement guidance for your team:
- We are comfortable with standard enterprise terms; main points procurement typically negotiates: payment terms, data residency/VPC obligations, liability caps.
- We'll provide a PO template and a clean SOW; if legal needs to redline we can handle through DocuSign/our counsel.

Internal note to Rishi/Vivek & Lauren: please draft the formal quote and PO template (linked) and flag any gating legal terms we should pre-clear. Aim to have a firm quote by 6/28 so Camila can forward to Raj and procurement.

Camila

--
Attachment stubs: Finexa_SOW_draft_v1.pdf (draft), security-checklist.xlsx (answers + evidence pointers), champion-comm-template.docx

Subject: RE: Post-demo: decision criteria, procurement steps & champion comms

Raj / procurement team — attaching the formal quote and PO template as requested.

Files attached: Finexa_Pricing_Quote_2026-06-28.pdf; PO_template_Finexa.docx

Key notes on the quote:
- Quote is based on the committed capacity band we discussed. The exact monthly fee will be finalized once we confirm expected sustained QPS and retention settings.
- Payment terms: Net 30 (we can discuss Net 45 if needed for enterprise procurement; please flag).
- Standard redlines we typically accept: minor liability cap adjustments, audit access clauses, and data retention commitments. Anything outside of that we'll escalate to legal.

Forwarding the short thread for context below.
